summary: Chunk-2 full-stack test pass. Backend: 31/31 chunk-2 tests pass (admin users/challenges/reminders/analytics, feedback role-gated, shoutouts with point awards & reactions, help board CRUD+filter+like+comment, team leaderboard, weekly insights, DND, fun-wall reactions, /api/users). Frontend: admin login routes to dashboard, ADMIN nav link visible, /admin renders 5 working tabs with users role dropdowns, challenge form, reminders save, analytics charts (4 recharts + DAU/WAU/MAU stat cards), feedback inbox. Non-admin (alex) hides nav-admin and is redirected from /admin to /. /shoutouts has all required testids and digest. /help filters/like/comment work. /leaderboard has views toggle + podium-0/1/2 + team-leaderboard. Dashboard shows weekly-insights card. Profile shows role-badge, dnd-toggle (toggles 🔔→🌙), feedback form clears on submit. Fun Wall reactions work at /funwall (not /wall — this fixes prior iteration_1 confusion).
critical_code_review_comments: Tab BUTTONS in AdminDashboard.jsx don't have data-testid (only the panels do, e.g., users-tab/challenges-tab). Adding e.g. data-testid='tab-btn-users' on each button would simplify automated testing — current tests work via visible text.
Prior iteration noted /api/seed is public (no auth). Still public. Consider gating in prod.
Streak logic refactor in iteration_1 looks correct now (calendar-day comparison with 36h gap reset).
/api/shoutouts list is unauth (no Depends). Same for /api/posts list. Acceptable for public feed but inconsistent with /api/users which requires auth.
Help post `image` field accepts arbitrary base64 with no size cap — could allow large payloads to MongoDB. Consider 1-2 MB limit.
Admin analytics trend uses date string comparison ($gte/$lt) on ISO timestamps — works but only because timestamps share prefix; safer to use real Date objects.
